scripts.build: pnpm clean && ncc build src/index.ts -o dist && babel dist --out-dir dist && node -e "const { cpSync } = require('fs'); cpSync('images', 'dist/images', { recursive: true }); cpSync('plugin.json', 'dist/plugin.json');"
scripts.package: pnpm build && node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const { existsSync, unlinkSync, renameSync } = require('fs'); const wox = 'Wox.Plugin.Spotify.wox'; const zip = 'Wox.Plugin.Spotify.zip'; if (existsSync(wox)) unlinkSync(wox); if (existsSync(zip)) unlinkSync(zip); execSync('tar -C dist -a -cf ' + zip + ' index.js plugin.json images', { stdio: 'inherit' }); renameSync(zip, wox);"
scripts.dev: nodemon --watch src --watch images --watch plugin.json --ext json,ts,js,mjs,png --exec pnpm run build
scripts.clean: node -e "var { rmSync, existsSync } = require('fs'), path = require('path'); ['./dist'].forEach(fPath => {if (existsSync(path.join(__dirname, fPath))) rmSync(path.join(__dirname, fPath), { recursive: true, force: true })}); process.exit(0);"
